d:
Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath was seen getting emotional as he bid farewell to his mother, Savitri Devi, in his ancestral village of Panchur in Uttarakhand. He shouldered her mortal remains as the final journey began towards Haridwar, where her last rites were scheduled to be performed. Savitri Devi passed away on November 20 at the age of 91.
